name: LP333 ID4 and ID5 Kissat SAT-discovery schedule
hypothesis: Removing proof-logging overhead and using the pinned Kissat 4.0.4 satisfiable-target configuration on the strongest audited unary-channel formulas may discover at least one directly verifiable LP333 model within the fixed two-arm schedule.
evidence_unit: a deterministic sequential portfolio over the full-PAF unary-channel formulas in order ID4 then ID5, each with at most 3600 solver seconds, stopping immediately on a directly verified SAT model
claim_boundary: Only a complete model that satisfies the exact serialized CNF and independently passes all row, subgroup-invariance, and 332 direct PAF checks decides a named fixed family. An UNSAT solver status without a replayable proof makes no mathematical claim.

baseline.evidence: The proof-producing unary-channel runs remained UNKNOWN: ID4 after 300 seconds and ID5 after both 300 seconds and a preregistered one-hour follow-through.
baseline.measurement: No directly verified SAT model exists for fixed families ID4 or ID5 in the campaign ledger.

intervention.one_change: Replace the proof-producing CaDiCaL search arm with official pinned Kissat 4.0.4 commit 8af8e56f174b778aef3aa45af9f739b2a5f492c2 using its documented --sat target configuration, no proof output, and otherwise fixed default seed zero. Keep each exact audited formula unchanged and run the fixed order ID4 then ID5.
forbidden_confounds: changed translation gauge or symmetry clauses
resource-cap extension after observing an arm

controls.name: official-tool-pin
controls.expected: Kissat reports version 4.0.4, binary SHA-256 ca26c445800f6a88caebe925ee5b60d0907da4f1c8418f4044a51b1a22224983, source commit 8af8e56f174b778aef3aa45af9f739b2a5f492c2, and all 869 upstream build tests pass.

controls.name: sat-positive-control
controls.purpose: Check status and complete-model extraction before target search.
controls.expected: The pinned solver returns SAT on the known SAT ID3 cell-73 CNF and its emitted complete assignment satisfies every serialized clause.

controls.name: formula-and-audit-binding
controls.purpose: Hold the exact strongest ID4 and ID5 formulas fixed.
controls.expected: Each formula hash matches its generated metadata and passing independent unary-channel audit; generator, parent, translation gauge, primary variables, and all three redundant channels are unchanged.

controls.name: direct-target-model-audit
controls.purpose: Prevent solver status from being mistaken for a mathematical candidate.
controls.expected: Any target SAT assignment satisfies every CNF clause, reconstructs two length-333 sign sequences with row sums plus or minus one, is invariant under the named subgroup, has combined PAF minus two at every nonzero shift, and fails after a controlled coordinate mutation.

controls.name: proofless-unsat-boundary
controls.expected: Any Kissat UNSAT status is recorded only as proofless search evidence and triggers a separately preregistered proof-producing follow-up before family closure.

terminal_outcomes.promote: At least one arm returns SAT and its complete assignment passes the exact CNF and direct full-length mathematical audit.
terminal_outcomes.park: Both fixed arms finish or reach their caps without a SAT model, including any proofless UNSAT statuses, and all binding controls remain valid.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A wall, memory, tool, or model-extraction ceiling prevents completion of the frozen two-arm schedule.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any tool pin, positive control, formula binding, complete-model check, CNF check, direct PAF check, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Run the positive control and all formula audits before the first target arm.
Run exactly ID4 then ID5 with Kissat --sat, seed zero, and no other option changes.
Stop the schedule immediately after a directly verified SAT model.
Terminate each target at 3600 solver seconds or 4 GiB observed RSS.
Do not promote or close a family from a proofless UNSAT status.
Do not rerun with another seed, mode, family order, or larger cap.

next_actions.promote: Archive the audited LP333 pair, construct the corresponding two-circulant H668 candidate, and independently verify and package the submission artifact.
next_actions.park: Archive both non-SAT manifests and move to a distinct structural family mechanism rather than another SAT configuration.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the partial schedule and resume only the unexecuted frozen arm under the same remaining budget.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest failed tool, binding, extraction, or direct-check control before any new target run.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, and the official open-source Kissat checkout are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
